xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-4852: SageOx in Overdeck, part A: try it without committing, Overdeck-built ox, Codex, fork rebase

plan.title: SageOx in Overdeck, part A: try it without committing, Overdeck-built ox, Codex, fork rebase
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

metadata.sizeJustification: The operator already split SageOx part A (core) from part B (dashboard, PAN-4853); auto mode does not re-scope the issue's acceptance, which binds the fork rebase, the Overdeck-built ox, link/placement/switch-off, the merge guard plus commit, and Codex into this issue. Items are small, independently testable slices with a DAG; PRD section 11 gives the A1/A2/A3 sibling split if the operator wants Flywheel parallelism (precedent: PAN-4820 AD-21).

narratives.Problem: Using SageOx in an Overdeck project today means committing .sageox/ to the repository, building ox by hand into ~/.local/bin, and giving up on Codex launches; the eltmon/ox fork is 297 commits behind upstream.
narratives.Proposal: Rebase the fork onto upstream v0.25.0 as new branches and pin the pack to it; build ox (plus the Claude Code and Codex adapters) under ~/.overdeck/packs/sageox at pack add/update/sync with a consent preview and an isolated Go env; store a per-project binding created by `pan skills pack sageox link` (host-managed ox init in a throwaway worktree); at launch place it into the issue worktree or primary checkout, hidden through a generalized worktree-exclude module shared with PAN-4820, and remove it at the next launch when SageOx is off; refuse .sageox/ in PRs unless the project ran `pan skills pack sageox commit`; give Codex launches six pre-trusted ox agent hook entries in the per-agent CODEX_HOME.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Dashboard views for SageOx (part B, PAN-4853)
- Any upstream sageox/ox contact: no push, PR, issue or comment; no PR on the fork either
- Force-pushing or moving the existing overdeck-base or overdeck/host-managed fork branches
- Remote (Fly) launches
- Harnesses other than Claude Code and Codex
- Polyrepo workspaces for placement and the merge guard
- Writing to ~/.local/bin or using an ox found on PATH
- Running ox login, reading auth.json contents, or running the live link flow as an agent (operator-only)
- Using --dangerously-bypass-hook-trust for Codex
- Running git stash
- Raising any file-size allowlist row

autoDecisions.summary: Fork rebase pushes new branches overdeck-base-v<tag> and overdeck/host-managed-v<tag>; no PR anywhere
autoDecisions.rationale: D7 forbids force pushes to existing branches, and gh pr create in a fork defaults to upstream, which D7 forbids.

autoDecisions.summary: Fallback to the next older upstream tag (v0.24.2 … v0.23.0) when the rebased fork fails its tests
autoDecisions.rationale: Issue checkpoint 3 fallback, made mechanical; never weaken a fork test.
Same as pstack; pan skills pack add sageox then needs no --ref and the pin never moves silently.

autoDecisions.summary: Build ox, ox-adapter-claude-code and ox-adapter-codex into <packdir>/<commit>/bin
autoDecisions.rationale: ox forks ox-adapter-<agent> found next to the ox binary to record sessions; without it Codex recording is silent (upstream issue #519).

autoDecisions.summary: Build env sets GOCACHE, GOMODCACHE, GOPATH and XDG_CONFIG_HOME under the pack dir plus GOFLAGS=-modcacherw
autoDecisions.rationale: Verified in planning: without XDG_CONFIG_HOME Go writes ~/.config/go/telemetry; -modcacherw keeps the pack dir deletable.

autoDecisions.summary: Build readiness comes from a marker file and the directory, not from ox host-contract's commit
autoDecisions.rationale: An archive build has no VCS stamp, so host-contract reports commit ""; doctor would otherwise warn on every machine.

autoDecisions.summary: No PATH fallback: launches, hooks, probes and doctor use only the built ox
autoDecisions.rationale: D5; ox on PATH on this machine is upstream 0.2.0.

autoDecisions.summary: pan skills pack remove sageox keeps bindings/
autoDecisions.rationale: A binding needs ox login and the network to recreate and re-running ox init may register a second repo.

autoDecisions.summary: The binding is every untracked, non-ignored file ox init creates under .sageox/ (usually five), max 50, must include config.json
autoDecisions.rationale: Matches exactly what a commit would contain without hard-coding the .repo_<uuid> name.

autoDecisions.summary: link runs ox init in a detached throwaway worktree under the pack dir, with a fresh-clone fallback, and polls ox status up to 120 s for the ledger clone before removing it
autoDecisions.rationale: Issue D1 and checkpoint 1; recording needs the ledger clone (fork ledger CP-1), and the ledger path is keyed by repo_id, not by the worktree.

autoDecisions.summary: Four .sageox/ states at launch: tracked, placed (marker), hand-made (untouched), absent
autoDecisions.rationale: D2/D3 cover only absent vs placed; an operator's own untracked .sageox/ must never be overwritten or deleted.

autoDecisions.summary: Switch-off checks only <cwd>/.sageox/.overdeck-placed and runs no git call when it is absent
autoDecisions.rationale: Every Overdeck launch cwd is the root where placement happens; keeps the off path cheap for launches that never used SageOx.

autoDecisions.summary: New src/lib/git/worktree-exclude.ts with per-owner blocks; Deft is repointed to it if PAN-4820 merged
autoDecisions.rationale: One core.excludesFile per worktree means Deft and SageOx must share one file; the issue asks to generalize rather than copy.

autoDecisions.summary: The SageOx merge guard applies to every issue in every project when the gate is otherwise ready, fails closed, and counts a default branch that already tracks .sageox/ as committed
autoDecisions.rationale: D4 literal scope with bounded cost; a project that committed .sageox/ before Overdeck must still merge its legitimate updates.

autoDecisions.summary: Guards compose in src/lib/cloister/repo-merge-guards.ts with one call per merge door (Deft first, then SageOx)
autoDecisions.rationale: D4 says extend PAN-4820's guard; one composed call per door avoids divergent wiring.

autoDecisions.summary: commit records sageox_binding: committed only after the PR is opened, and uses git add -f
autoDecisions.rationale: A failed run records nothing; a primary-checkout info/exclude block hides .sageox/ in every worktree.

autoDecisions.summary: Codex: Overdeck owns <codexHome>/hooks.json and writes trusted_hash entries computed with Codex's own algorithm, never --dangerously-bypass-hook-trust
autoDecisions.rationale: Codex 0.159 runs untrusted hooks never; the hash algorithm was reproduced exactly against a real trusted entry; bypass would also run a repo's .codex/hooks.json unreviewed.

autoDecisions.summary: pan skills pack sageox status gains a link column (committed | held | none)
autoDecisions.rationale: The operator needs to see whether link ran; part B reads the same function.
The operator already split part A from part B; auto mode does not re-scope acceptance (PAN-4820 precedent).

items.title: Rebase the eltmon/ox fork onto the newest upstream release as new -v<tag> branches

expected_outputs: go test exits 0 at the rebased head
metadata.readinessReason: Runs in the external fork clone; its only Overdeck file is docs/SAGEOX-FORK.md, serialized before docs.

narrative.Action: PRD WI-1: in ~/Projects/ox-pan-2444 fetch upstream, create overdeck-base-<tag> at the newest upstream release tag (expected v0.25.0) and rebase overdeck/host-managed onto it as overdeck/host-managed-<tag>; keep every host-managed behavior (F2-F6), gate any new Codex repo write under OX_HOST_MANAGED, run the fork tests, push only the two new branches to origin (never --force, never upstream, no PR anywhere), apply the AD-2 older-tag fallback on failure, re-read codexHookEvents at the new head, and update docs/SAGEOX-FORK.md (branch rows, F7 entry, Building section).

items.title: Given the rebase, when `git ls-remote origin` runs in the fork clone, then it returns `overdeck-base-v<tag>` at the upstream tag commit and `overdeck/host-managed-v<tag>`, and the existing `overdeck-base` and `overdeck/host-managed` refs keep their old commits
`go test ./... -count=1` exits 0 at the head of `overdeck/host-managed-v<tag>`, and the ledger records the command and result
`docs/SAGEOX-FORK.md` shows the new base and head commits in the Branches table and an `F7 fork-rebase` entry naming the tag and the conflicts resolved
`git remote get-url --push upstream` in the fork clone still prints `DISABLED`, and no ref, PR or issue was created on sageox/ox
Add the ox build module (go build into <packdir>/<commit>/bin with an isolated Go env)

narrative.Action: PRD WI-2: new src/lib/skill-packs/ox-build.ts (node:* imports only) exporting OX_BUILD_MARKER, OX_BINARIES (ox, ox-adapter-claude-code, ox-adapter-codex), OxBuildError, oxBuildEnv (GOCACHE/GOMODCACHE/GOPATH/XDG_CONFIG_HOME under goDir, GOFLAGS -modcacherw), oxBuildCommands, assertGoAvailable, oxBuildDownloads, isOxBuildReady and buildOx with an injectable runner; failure removes bin/, the marker is written last.

items.title: Given an injected runner, when `buildOx` runs, then it executes `go build -o <extract>/bin/<name> ./cmd/<name>` for ox, ox-adapter-claude-code and ox-adapter-codex with cwd = the extraction and env GOCACHE, GOMODCACHE, GOPATH and XDG_CONFIG_HOME all under goDir and GOFLAGS containing `-modcacherw`
After a successful build `isOxBuildReady(dir, commit)` returns true, and returns false for a different commit or when `bin/.overdeck-ox-build.json` is missing
When the second go build fails, `buildOx` throws an OxBuildError whose message ends with the stderr tail and leaves no `bin/` directory
When `go version` fails, `assertGoAvailable` rejects with exactly `pack sageox needs go on PATH (https://go.dev/dl/)`
Build ox at pack add, update and sync, with a consent preview naming commands, paths and downloads

narrative.Action: PRD WI-3: for id sageox, addPack and updatePack (when the commit moves) set PackPreview.oxBuild {commands, writes, downloads} before confirm and build after consent before the registry write; syncPack builds a not-ready trusted commit without asking; Go missing maps to PackSourceError('render', 'pack sageox needs go on PATH (https://go.dev/dl/)'); printPackPreview prints Builds, Writes and Downloads rows.

items.title: Given `addPack` for sageox, when confirm is called, then the preview's `oxBuild.commands` names `<packdir>/<commit>/bin/ox` and `oxBuild.writes` names `<packdir>/<commit>/bin/` and `<packdir>/go/`
A declined confirm creates no registry entry and runs no build; an accepted add returns with `isOxBuildReady` true before the registry entry is written
`syncPack('sageox')` with a deleted `bin/` creates it again and returns without calling confirm
`pan skills pack add sageox` without --yes on a TTY prints `Builds`, `Writes` and `Downloads` rows before the trust question

`pan skills pack remove sageox` prints `kept SageOx link files in <packdir>/bindings/` when the binding store exists
`removePack` for any other pack id still deletes the whole pack dir
Pin KNOWN_PACKS.sageox.ref to the rebased fork head

Generalize the hide into src/lib/git/worktree-exclude.ts with per-owner blocks (Deft and SageOx share one file)

expected_outputs: worktree-exclude.test.ts passes (and PAN-4820's install/uninstall tests when present)
metadata.acJustification: Five criteria: the module plus the conditional PAN-4820 repoint must both be verified.
metadata.readinessReason: Owns new src/lib/git/worktree-exclude.ts; the only item touching src/lib/deft/.

narrative.Action: PRD WI-9: excludeTarget (linked worktree -> <gitdir>/info/overdeck-exclude via git config --worktree core.excludesFile with extensions.worktreeConfig, seeded with a copy of the global excludes; primary checkout -> info/exclude), setExcludeBlock/readExcludeBlock/removeExcludeBlock with '# overdeck:<owner> begin/end' blocks; checkpoint: if PAN-4820 merged, repoint src/lib/deft install/uninstall to this module with the legacy overdeck-deft-exclude cleanup.

items.title: Given a linked worktree, when `setExcludeBlock(worktree, 'sageox', ['/.sageox/'])` runs, then a new `.sageox/config.json` there is absent from `git status --porcelain`, while an untracked `.sageox/` in the primary checkout still shows

In the primary checkout the block is written to `.git/info/exclude`, an unrelated existing line is preserved byte-for-byte, and `removeExcludeBlock` restores the other lines
A pattern from the global excludes file still applies in the worktree after `setExcludeBlock`

When PAN-4820's src/lib/deft/install.ts exists, its hide applies `setExcludeBlock(worktree, 'deft', …)` and `npx vitest run src/lib/deft/__tests__/install.test.ts src/lib/deft/__tests__/uninstall.test.ts` exits 0

Place the binding into a launch root and hide it, respecting tracked and hand-made .sageox/

items.title: Given SageOx placement for one issue worktree, `<worktree>/.sageox/config.json` exists, `git status --porcelain` in that worktree prints nothing, and neither the primary checkout nor a second worktree has `.sageox/`
Placement in the primary checkout writes a `# overdeck:sageox begin` block in `.git/info/exclude` and `git status --porcelain` prints nothing
